title: Trust gates on agent-authored pull requests: replication package for "Engineering Trust When AI Writes Your Software"
description:
Replication package for the case study in Engineering Trust When AI Writes Your Software (M. Vieira, A. Reddy, V. Devabhaktuni; IEEE Computer, under review). It contains the config-driven runner and four trust gates (interface resolution, mutation on changed lines against the package suite and against the change's own tests, and per-PR claim checks), the configuration for eight Copilot-agent pull requests merged into Azure/azure-sdk-for-python, the evidence records obtained and an independent re-run on a second machine, the independent rater's blind classification of the requirements, full walkthroughs of two pull requests and one-page cards for the other six, the bug reports filed with the project, and the methodology and runbook.

The gate tooling, claim checks and triage were produced with an AI assistant under the first author's direction and reproduced by the authors; the requirement classification of record was performed by a human rater without AI assistance.
